title: Desk Quick Reference: Free Ship-to-Home Shipping Under Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus
content:
**Rule.** For **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus** members, the tier held on the order date sets the free-shipping threshold for ship-to-home retail orders: the tier's order free-shipping threshold. A past-due paid tier uses the threshold of the free tier its spend supports, and a pending downgrade membership keeps its paid threshold until the cancellation takes effect. Autoship and pharmacy shipping follow their own program rules, where an active paid tier waives the standard fee.

**Which threshold applies**

| Membership on the order date | Threshold used for a ship-to-home retail order |
|---|---|
| a free tier | that free tier's threshold |
| a paid tier, active | the paid tier's threshold |
| a paid tier, pending downgrade | the paid tier's threshold, until the cancellation takes effect |
| a paid tier, past due | the threshold of the free tier its spend supports |

**Examples (hypothetical).**
- A Tailwise Plus Annual member whose membership is past due, with spend supporting Pals Rewards Insider, places a ship-to-home order: the Pals Rewards Insider threshold applies to it.
- A Tailwise Plus Monthly member who has cancelled, with the cancellation not yet in effect, keeps the Tailwise Plus Monthly threshold on orders placed before the end of the billing month.
- The tier held on the order date decides; a tier change after the order date does not change the threshold of that order.
